subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add a scoped prompt/config contract to omit the human-readable Tooling list while preserving direct callable tool schemas, or should users use existing Tool Search/localModelLean and broader #14785 work instead?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a new prompt/config contract in an area where repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces.

options.title: Add scoped opt-in
options.body: Add a narrow option that suppresses only the Tooling list text while preserving structured callable tool definitions and updating docs, reporting, and tests.

options.title: Fold into #14785
options.body: Keep this issue as partial overlap or consolidate it under the broader tool-schema overhead plan if maintainers want one canonical optimization track.

options.title: Document existing mitigations
options.body: Decline a new config surface and document Tool Search/localModelLean as the supported token-reduction path despite not preserving the exact current schema exposure mode.

recommendation.title: Add scoped opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a narrow option that suppresses only the Tooling list text while preserving structured callable tool definitions and updating docs, reporting, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent prompt/runtime history points to this area, and the decision is about the core prompt/config contract rather than a plugin-only change.
